title: pm(queue-guard): enumerateRows reads diff-tree without -z, so a governed path with a non-ASCII or control character is quoted and matches no governed prefix
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: at-tier delta review 6888217778 on PR #33531, card #33501, found this outside its diff, from reading the code, not from a run).

`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` `enumerateRows` lists a merge group's paths with `git diff-tree -r --no-commit-id --no-renames --name-only` (both the range read and the per-commit read) without `-z`, and nothing sets `core.quotePath=false`. Git then prints a path holding a non-ASCII or control character as a C-quoted string (`"skills/x/\346\226\207.md"`), which matches no governed prefix. Inside the low-risk arm this fails closed to Tier H; outside it, the queue leg does not see that governed file at all.

## What lands

1. Every path read in `enumerateRows` (and any sibling read in `check-governed-merges.mjs` that lists paths for a governed match) uses `-z` and splits on NUL, as the arm's own `catalogFilesOf` and the carried-head read (`git diff -z --name-only --no-renames`) already do.
2. A self-test row with a non-ASCII path and a path with a newline under a governed prefix, read through the real-git fixture (`gitFreeEnv()`), proving the path is governed.

Wait for #33531 to merge first (same file). Sized p2.
